body: apps2/emily-bot/main.go: -replay-dir flag writes NDJSON per tick to var/replays/YYYYMMDD-HHmmssZ.ndjson. Each record: {tick, state, action}. State built from dead-reckoning position + peers in Go (parallel to Python serializer). Action string matches game_state.py encode_action format. logReplay() called every think() tick.
title: S39-02: replay logger in emily-bot
